name: Tau Ceti e
tagline: Una super-Tera inte la sona abitabiłe de l'estêla singolâ pi vicină — sul lat pi chalt de la sperança.

facts.label: Sona
facts.value: Warm inner edge of the habitable zone

history: Tau Ceti e sits around the nearest quiet G-type star — an older, calmer twin of the Sun with ten times Earth's asteroid dust. The candidate super-Earth completes a 'year' in 163 days at about half Earth's distance, placing it on the warm inner edge of the habitable zone — close enough that a mild greenhouse could leave it temperate, or Venus-like if clouds fail. Its signal is a whiplash-faint ~55 cm/s radial-velocity wobble, still debated among teams because Tau Ceti is almost too smooth — the star's very quietness makes the planet's whisper hard to prove. If confirmed it would be one of the nearest temperate worlds known.
source: Tuomi et al. (2012) · Feng et al. (2017)
